package.name: geoloc_common
package.description:
Header-only geometry and estimation primitives shared by every geoloc node: WGS84/ENU conversion, SE(2), geo-referenced rasters, covariance validation.
Having ONE implementation of each is deliberate. A half-pixel convention mismatch or a divergent angle normalisation between two nodes produces a constant offset that looks exactly like matcher bias and is very hard to attribute.
